scope.summary: Implement face export (spec 13.23/13.26 boundary; AREQ-007, the Daz FACS-export-gap fix): every skeletal export lane emits the ARKit-52 blendshapes with exact names by default, the FACS extended set optionally per profile, expression assets as baked named combos, with round-trip verification contracts registered into the MT-624 Blender/UE harness and blendshape-budget linting (GREQ-012).
acceptance_criteria: Every skeletal export lane emits ARKit-52 blendshapes with exact Apple names by default - the guaranteed baseline; the Daz FACS-behind-ERC-boards export gap is the named anti-pattern (AREQ-007).
FACS extended set exports optionally per profile flag; expression assets export as baked, named blendshape combos alongside the units.
Round-trip verification: a headless Blender import script asserts all 52 shapes present and deforming; the UE-side check contract registers into the MT-624 harness.
Export validation counts face blendshapes into budget lint (GREQ-012): warn above the documented per-mesh shape budget, flag when the face is merged into the body mesh.
scope.risk_if_missed: Daz's hundreds-of-morphs-behind-controller-dials export gap is a documented forum pain point; a face that exports without guaranteed ARKit-52 names cannot be driven by any standard mocap or engine pipeline, voiding the AREQ-007 interchange promise.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Integrate production oral and ocular assets, rigging, materials, close-up expression/pose, and export validation.
